scripts.build: NODE_PATH=./node_modules esbuild src/entry.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=bundle.js --log-level=warning && NODE_PATH=./node_modules esbuild src/outline-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --define:import.meta.url=location.href --outfile=outline.bundle.js --log-level=warning
scripts.render: npm run build && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render --gpu --output out/hf.mp4
scripts.render:outline: npm run build && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render --gpu -c compositions/outline.html --output out/outline.mp4
